blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Influenza-like illness (ILI) remained the most frequently reported among diseases in Manila, with 18 new cases recorded on Monday, bringing the city’s year-to-date total to 1,955, according to the latest W.I.L.D. diseases report covering water-borne diseases, influenza, leptospirosis and dengue.
